ONGC Geologists and Engineers E1 Online Form 2026 – Last Date - Complete Details

Short Information : Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has released the notification for the Geologists and Engineers E1 post. This recruitment has been issued for 52 posts. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official Sarkari Result 2026, Online applying process for ONGC Geologists and Engineers E1 Recruitment 2026 has started from 17 July 2026 & the candidates can apply till 31 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for ONGC Geologists and Engineers E1 Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 July 2026
  • Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 06 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • GEN /OBC/EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC/ST/PwBD : Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
